name: Bacteria-feeding nematodes
description: Nematodes that graze on bacteria ('bacteriophagous nematodes' in the source); with amoebae they account for most of the nitrogen mineralized by soil animals in this prairie. Functional group pooling all bacterial-feeding nematode species, grouped by the source on the basis of their shared diet. Reported biomass (metrics.biomass) is in kg C per hectare, yearly average, from Table A1 of van Altena et al. 2016.
